The StbM shall perform Rate Correctio n measurements to determine the rate deviation of each configured Time Base.

For Rate Correction, the StbM shall eval uate the TIMELEAP _FUTURE/ TIMELEAP_ PAST flag s during the start of a measurement. The StbM shall not start a Rate Correction measurement when the state of any of the flags equals „Set“ .
For Rate Correction measurements, the StbM shall evaluate the TIMEOUT flag. The StbM shall discard the measurement , if the flag equals „Set“ .
For Rate Correction measurements, the StbM shall evaluate state changes of the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY flag during measurements. The S tbM shall discard the measurement if the flag state changes.

For Rate Correction measurements, the StbM shall evaluate the TIMELEAP _FUTURE and TIMELEAP_PAST flag s during measurements. The StbM shall discard the measurement , if any of the flags equals „Set“ .
The StbM shall not perform Rate Correction when the measurement duration StbMRateCorrectionMeasurementDuration ( ECUC_StbM_00054 : ) is set to zero.
